note: Paths a file tool (Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, Codex apply_patch, opencode write, edit and apply_patch, pi edit and write, Hermes write_file and patch) may not change without a human (tools.mjs). A glob starting with ~/ or / is anchored there; any other matches at any depth. ** crosses directories, * and ? do not. `prod: true` counts only when the path points at production (the prod-destroy markers and a team policy's prod list). The Reflex checkout, its logs and its settings directory are always protected. config.json "protected" adds globs; a copy in ~/.config/reflex/tool-gate/protected.json replaces this file; a team policy can only add globs.
